Sourced from org.hibernate.validator:hibernate-validator's releases.

Release 6.2.6.Final

Hibernate Validator 6.2.6.Final released

We are pleased to announce the release of Hibernate Validator 6.2: 6.2.6.Final.

You can find the full list of 6.2.6.Final changes here.

What's new

This release introduces a few minor improvements as well as bug fixes.

Conclusion

For additional details, see:

the release page

the Migration Guide

the Getting started

the Reference Guide

the API docs

Visit the website for details on getting in touch with us.
sections.pr_body_changelog:
Sourced from org.hibernate.validator:hibernate-validator's changelog.

6.2.6.Final (2026-10-13)

https://hibernate.atlassian.net/projects/HV/versions/35289

** Bug
* HV-2256 addMessageParameter fix
* HV-2231 RegexpURLValidator throws NPE when URL has no authority component
* HV-2164 NIP constraint javadoc incorrectly states that it is a 9 digit sequence

** Improvement
* HV-2214 Enable automatic releases
* HV-2186 Update jakarta.enterprise.cdi-api to 2.0.2
* HV-2185 Update jakarta.interceptor-api to 1.2.5
* HV-2184 Update jakarta.ejb-api to 3.2.6
* HV-2183 Update jakarta.el to 3.0.4
* HV-2182 Update JBoss Logging to 3.4.3
* HV-2157 Point to docs.hibernate.org instead of docs.jboss.org/hibernate in various docs
* HV-2138 Include license file in the META-INF of published artifacts

** Task
* HV-2244 Tune the content of javadoc jars to reduce the size of files published to Maven Central
* HV-2192 Use Maven 3.9.13 as a required minimum version for the build
* HV-2142 Stage documentation and javadocs to projectroot/target/staging-deploy/documentation

sections.release_notes:
## 6.2.6.Final
# Hibernate Validator 6.2.6.Final released

We are pleased to announce the release of Hibernate Validator 6.2: 6.2.6.Final.

You can find the full list of 6.2.6.Final changes [here](https://hibernate.atlassian.net/issues/?jql=project%20%3D%20HV%20AND%20fixVersion%20%3D%206.2.6.Final).

## What's new

This release introduces a few minor improvements as well as bug fixes.

## Conclusion

For additional details, see:

- the [release page](https://hibernate.org/validator/releases/6.2/)
- the [Migration Guide](https://docs.hibernate.org/validator/6.2/migration-guide/)
- the [Getting started](https://docs.hibernate.org/validator/6.2/reference/en-US/html_single/#validator-gettingstarted)
- the [Reference Guide](https://docs.hibernate.org/validator/6.2/reference/en-US/html_single/)
- the [API docs](https://docs.hibernate.org/validator/6.2/api)

Visit the [website](https://hibernate.org/community/) for details on getting in touch with us.
